# MP89 retained current targets and exact-build resource fields

`target_effect_real.json` projects all14 original first-current SelectTargets
endpoints from the owner-authenticated MP81 archive (3,225,997 bytes, SHA256
`1d75cd1b65ac868da1e9e0025032c7380317fcbf8669016a00fcb536e44a73ac`).
There are12 complete local domains: one legacy Stack Card domain, two mixed
Stack Ability domains and nine players-only Stack Ability domains. The other
two endpoints are Unselect-only, not complete Select domains.

The seven startup resource lines are actual whitelisted fields from original
lines59,78,82,83,84,85,86. They retain the exact build, official exact-build
pointer, two Audio/Localization selections, one Automatic main manifest and its
completion. They are a filtered projection, not authentication of raw bytes or
a signed capability. Tests add explicitly synthetic authentication/Full wrappers
and a clock; these do not become additional real MTGA evidence.

Current type/visibility, source catalog and ability IDs, player/life/team facts,
target order/operation/counts, turn fields and prompt parameter shapes are
retained. Request/state/instance/zone/ability-instance/prompt/unrelated-catalog
identities are aliases. Prompt CardId parameters remain typed instance aliases,
never catalog lookup evidence. Highlight values are presentation aliases.
Hidden entities and zone members, account/authentication data and local paths
are omitted. Only the current public/own-visible field slice is represented;
these are not raw-equivalent Full messages. No later target response is included.

`target_effect_reference_real.json` is the complete detached result of the
production `prepare_mtga_target_effect_reference` factory on the actual official
offline database. The exact two source catalogs retain their four complete
reviewed ability rows, generic/card-specific texts and cost/embedded-creator
distinctions. No synthetic database or card-name lookup creates the positive
reference. The independent reviewer directly ran the factory on actual source
bytes and compared every projected field. Public CI uses the projection and
does not claim to authenticate the private source database.

The historical resource chain and source hashes are documented in
`docs/target-effect-research.md` and its safe evidence receipt. These fixtures
prove bounded current identities, fixed BASE instructions and research behavior;
they do not prove actual damage, dynamic effects, legality, strategic optimality,
server acceptance, response encoding or permission to send input.

All mutated data and invented response envelopes in tests are negative controls,
not further real positives or policy training labels. Historical comparisons are
separate owner-only strict consumed full-stage observations, frozen after the
rule was fixed and before any later response was read for comparison.
